messages:
jaz_cs: Drafting a tiny "Go-live Pulse" one-pager for AMs/CSMs. Focus: safe defaults to reduce cold starts, what signals mean "reach out", and a paste-ready snippet + 1-line triage. Quick review?

mike_sre: love the name. keep defaults cautious for hosted. add a circuit-breaker reset note.

ella_am: call out renewal signals clearly: DAU drop >15% in 72h, <30% of expected sessions by day3, or >12% spike in support tickets -> AM outreach.

noor_se: paste-ready orchestrator snippet (hosted defaults):
```yaml
go_live_pulse:
  prefix_cache_ttl: 600        # 10m conservative
  kv_cache: true
  batch:
    enabled: true
    max_batch_size: 8         # conservative start
    max_latency_ms: 80        # flush if waiting longer
  streaming:
    enabled: true
    min_stream_tokens: 4      # stream earlier for perceived speed
  circuit_breaker:
    error_threshold: 0.08
    cool_down_secs: 180
```

jaz_cs: operator one-shot warmup (copy/paste):
```bash
for p in "welcome" "digest" "reply"; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-hosted-small","input":"'$p'","prefill":true}' &
done
wait
```

mike_sre: telemetry to surface day0-7: p95 latency, cache hit %, batch size median, streaming fallback %, error rate by route. target cache hit >60% after day1.

ella_am: handoff checklist (short): model + quantization, expected RPM, 3 eval prompts, renewal thresholds set, escalation contact.

noor_se: 1-line triage cheats: cache hit <40% -> check prefix keys/prefill job; p95 >900ms -> reduce max_batch_size or lower max_latency_ms; error % >CB -> open CB and page oncall.

jaz_cs: add feedback link in enablement emails: https://forms.redwood.example/go-live-pulse-feedback -> flags critical responses to AM queue. I'll push the one-pager to the repo EOD and tag AM rotation.
